blind.description: A stone gargoyle/rain spout or fountain chute. It features a rectangular mounting block of red/brown stone at the back, extending into an open trough channel carved from weathered greenish-tan stone with decorative acanthus leaf molding underneath the spout lip. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous, with clean game-ready low-poly stone texturing and no floating parts or mesh defects.
blind.from_above: A narrow open rectangular trough oriented vertically, capped with a wider flat rectangular block at the top and terminating in a carved floral/leafy rounded snout at the bottom.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1 foot tall (under 1/5 of the figure's height) and roughly 2.5 feet long.

notes: decorative acanthus leaf carving under lip
